The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 6.95 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

The judge's explanation, as written

Both sides agree on the core arithmetic, and the record supports it. Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance is the GPS trace figure, gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 26.44 km (EV-GPS-02801), not the rounded 26.4 km convenience copy on the trip record, against the booked optimal of 21.0 km (EV-TRIP-02801). That is an excess of 5.44 km, or 25.9% — beyond both establishment gates of 0.8 km and 20% — so a route deviation is established. It is below both materiality gates of 8.0 km and 50%, so it is not a MATERIAL deviation and POL-RD-06 is not engaged: no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c). Consistently, the driver profile shows deviation_flags_90d = 0 over completed_trips_90d = 191, so no repeat pattern is established. The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. That clause applies because the fare model is METERED (fare_breakdown.fare_model, EV-FARE-02801) and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance route. Surge is taken from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier = 1.2 — the only artifact carrying that field — and is not treated as absent. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 21.0 + 0.28 x 28.4) x 1.2 + 0.80 platform fee = (3.80 + 15.75 + 7.952) x 1.2 + 0.80 = 27.502 x 1.2 + 0.80 = 33.8024. Refund = charged_total 40.71 - 33.8024 = 6.9076, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 6.95. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and is 16.97% of charged_total, well below the 90% share that would convert this into a FULL_REFUND, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of 6.95. Nothing is added on top. The fare breakdown carries zero ERP lines, zero tolls, no airport surcharge and a 0.00 waiting-time fee, so POL-RD-09 yields no pass-through correction and no billing-integrity line; POL-RD-09(1) forbids adding off-route ERP to the POL-RD-02 figure in any event. No exculpatory clause reduces the excess: the chat log EV-CHAT-02801 holds 0 messages, so there is no POL-RD-04 rider instruction; the trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at null and both amended optimals null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply; and billed distance 26.4 km matches the traced 26.44 km, so no POL-RD-04 unbilled-distance compensation arises. The driver's stated explanation in the counterparty statement — 'Traffic was heavy so I took another road' — is an uncited traffic assertion. Under POL-RD-13 it is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip, and there is none on file: EV-ADVIS-02801-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. It neither reduces the excess nor supplies an amended optimal; the deviation stands at the measured figure under POL-RD-13(2). Because the driver named no evidence ID for an advisory, the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so it is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The GPS trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 208 fixes at a 10-second interval, zero gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s and 100% coverage, so POL-RD-07(a)-(c) and the escalation in POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged. Trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-02801) and the timestamps are consistent, and the refund is under both SGD 150.00 and charged_total, so no POL-RD-10 trigger fires. The rider's profile (deviation_claims_60d = 1) adds no corroboration hurdle. The confidence cap is 1.00: every artifact carrying the deciding facts — EV-GPS-02801, EV-TRIP-02801 and EV-FARE-02801 — has weight_multiplier 1.0, and the only impaired artifact, the missing advisory, carries nothing. The monetary effect of 6.95 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is executed automatically, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. No clause produces a referral on these facts. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

The rider advocate

kept A route deviation is established on this trip's own trace. The governing measurement under POL-RD-01 is gps_trace.trace_distance_km, which is 26.44 km, against a booked optimal of 21.0 km — an excess of 5.44 km, which clears the 0.8 km absolute limb of the establishment test many times over.

evidence EV-GPS-02801, EV-TRIP-02801 · clauses POL-RD-01

kept The percentage limb of POL-RD-01 also passes: the excess is 25.90% of the 21.0 km optimal route, above the 20% threshold. Both limbs must pass and both do. I have deliberately cited the trace figure (26.44 km, EV-GPS-02801) rather than the rounded 26.4 km convenience copy on the trip record, because POL-RD-01 says the trace governs where the two disagree.

evidence EV-GPS-02801, EV-TRIP-02801 · clauses POL-RD-01

These artifacts describe the same trip.

evidence EV-TRIP-02801, EV-GPS-02801, EV-FARE-02801 · clauses POL-RD-08

kept The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c): it runs 208 fixes at a 10 second sampling interval (well under the 30 second ceiling), reports zero gaps and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds, and covers 100.0% of the trip. The independent-corroboration requirement of POL-RD-07(ii) is therefore not engaged, and neither is the mandatory escalation in POL-RD-10(3).

evidence EV-GPS-02801 · clauses POL-RD-07

With no rider instruction on file, the corroboration test in POL-RD-04 cannot be satisfied and the clause is unavailable; no distance is excluded before POL-RD-01 and POL-RD-02 are applied.

evidence EV-CHAT-02801, EV-TRIP-02801 · clauses POL-RD-04

kept No pickup or dropoff relocation has occurred: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null on the trip record, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are both null. POL-RD-05 therefore cannot be run on this record and supplies no adjusted baseline.

evidence EV-TRIP-02801 · clauses POL-RD-05

kept This was not a pooled trip, so POL-RD-12 does not apply: trip_record.vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and the matched-itinerary baseline that clause uses is not in play. The solo optimal of 21.0 km on the trip record is the correct baseline.

evidence EV-TRIP-02801 · clauses POL-RD-12

kept The fare was metered, not upfront-quoted, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance-refund route: fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED and fare_breakdown.quoted_fare_sgd is null. POL-RD-02 is the clause that governs the refund on this trip.

evidence EV-FARE-02801 · clauses POL-RD-11, POL-RD-02

kept The driver's only explanation — 'Traffic was heavy so I took another road', recorded in the counterparty statement — is an uncited traffic assertion. POL-RD-03 requires a traffic_advisory record naming a road the optimal route traverses with an overlapping validity window, and there is none: EV-ADVIS-02801-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so the comparison cannot be run and POL-RD-03 is unavailable. Under POL-RD-08 a general assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID, does not discharge the driver's burden. Under POL-RD-13 the missing advisory is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation either, because the driver names no evidence ID for an advisory and an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one; the assertion is discarded and the deviation stands at the measured figure. evidence EV-ADVIS-02801-01, EV-TRIP-02801 · clauses POL-RD-03, POL-RD-08, POL-RD-13

evidence EV-FARE-02801 · clauses POL-RD-02

evidence EV-FARE-02801 · clauses POL-RD-02

The driver advocate

kept The deviation is established, but it is a small one: the GPS trace runs 26.44 km against the booked optimal of 21.0 km, an excess of 5.44 km or 25.9%. That clears POL-RD-01's establishment gate — more than 0.8 km and more than 20% — but it is well short of either materiality gate of 8.0 km or 50%, so this is an ordinary, non-MATERIAL deviation and must be treated as such.

evidence EV-GPS-02801, EV-TRIP-02801 · clauses POL-RD-01

kept The POL-RD-02 recomputation must carry the surge multiplier actually recorded on the fare breakdown — 1.2, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier — and must not treat surge as absent. On the optimal route the fare is (3.80 + 0.75 x 21.0 + 0.28 x 28.4) x 1.2 + 0.80 = 33.8024, so the refund is 40.71 - 33.8024 = 6.9076, rounded up to SGD 6.95. Reading surge as absent would inflate the refund to roughly 12.41 and is wrong on this record.

evidence EV-FARE-02801, EV-TRIP-02801 · clauses POL-RD-02

kept The refund of 6.9076 is only 16.97% of the 40.71 charged, far below the 90%-of-charged_total share that converts a POL-RD-02 computation into a FULL_REFUND. The correct ruling value is a PARTIAL_REFUND of the POL-RD-02 quantum, and nothing larger.

evidence EV-FARE-02801 · clauses POL-RD-02

evidence EV-FARE-02801 · clauses POL-RD-09

No pattern can be established on these two fields, which POL-RD-06 and POL-GEN-01 make the only citable profile fields for this test; the lifetime counters on the same artifact are context only.

evidence EV-DPROF-02801 · clauses POL-RD-06, POL-GEN-01

evidence EV-CHAT-02801, EV-TRIP-02801, EV-GPS-02801 · clauses POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-12

Both sides agree on the core arithmetic, and the record supports it. Under POL-RD-01 the governing distance is the GPS trace figure, gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 26.44 km (EV-GPS-02801), not the rounded 26.4 km convenience copy on the trip record, against the booked optimal of 21.0 km (EV-TRIP-02801). That is an excess of 5.44 km, or 25.9% — beyond both establishment gates of 0.8 km and 20% — so a route deviation is established. It is below both materiality gates of 8.0 km and 50%, so it is not a MATERIAL deviation and POL-RD-06 is not engaged: no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c). Consistently, the driver profile shows deviation_flags_90d = 0 over completed_trips_90d = 191, so no repeat pattern is established. The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. That clause applies because the fare model is METERED (fare_breakdown.fare_model, EV-FARE-02801) and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance route. Surge is taken from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier = 1.2 — the only artifact carrying that field — and is not treated as absent. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 21.0 + 0.28 x 28.4) x 1.2 + 0.80 platform fee = (3.80 + 15.75 + 7.952) x 1.2 + 0.80 = 27.502 x 1.2 + 0.80 = 33.8024. Refund = charged_total 40.71 - 33.8024 = 6.9076, rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 = 6.95. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and is 16.97% of charged_total, well below the 90% share that would convert this into a FULL_REFUND, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of 6.95. Nothing is added on top. The fare breakdown carries zero ERP lines, zero tolls, no airport surcharge and a 0.00 waiting-time fee, so POL-RD-09 yields no pass-through correction and no billing-integrity line; POL-RD-09(1) forbids adding off-route ERP to the POL-RD-02 figure in any event. No exculpatory clause reduces the excess: the chat log EV-CHAT-02801 holds 0 messages, so there is no POL-RD-04 rider instruction; the trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at null and both amended optimals null, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; the vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply; and billed distance 26.4 km matches the traced 26.44 km, so no POL-RD-04 unbilled-distance compensation arises. The driver's stated explanation in the counterparty statement — 'Traffic was heavy so I took another road' — is an uncited traffic assertion. Under POL-RD-13 it is tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip, and there is none on file: EV-ADVIS-02801-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. It neither reduces the excess nor supplies an amended optimal; the deviation stands at the measured figure under POL-RD-13(2). Because the driver named no evidence ID for an advisory, the absence is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so it is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. The GPS trace is not impaired for policy purposes: 208 fixes at a 10-second interval, zero gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s and 100% coverage, so POL-RD-07(a)-(c) and the escalation in POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged. Trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-02801) and the timestamps are consistent, and the refund is under both SGD 150.00 and charged_total, so no POL-RD-10 trigger fires. The rider's profile (deviation_claims_60d = 1) adds no corroboration hurdle. The confidence cap is 1.00: every artifact carrying the deciding facts — EV-GPS-02801, EV-TRIP-02801 and EV-FARE-02801 — has weight_multiplier 1.0, and the only impaired artifact, the missing advisory, carries nothing. The monetary effect of 6.95 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is executed automatically, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04.
